title: Prompt injection via delimiter attack succeeded in 2/5 test cases
observation: Direct injection tests using delimiter boundaries bypassed the system prompt in 2 out of 5 test cases. The agent executed injected instructions as if they were legitimate user input.
recommendation: Implement input sanitization and structured prompt boundaries. Add delimiter escaping before user input is concatenated into the prompt.

title: Excessive agency — agent writes to filesystem without human approval
observation: The agent has unrestricted write access to the entire filesystem. No human-in-the-loop checkpoint is required before file modification actions are executed.
recommendation: Restrict file-write tool to a designated output directory. Add a human approval step before any destructive file operation.

title: System prompt partially leaked via crafted user query
observation: A crafted user query caused the agent to reveal portions of its system prompt including internal instructions and the name of the orchestrating agent.
recommendation: Instruct the model never to repeat or paraphrase its system prompt. Add output filtering to detect and block accidental prompt disclosure.
